```{r setup}
library(terra)
library(knitr)

m_lines <- readLines(params$manifest, warn = FALSE)
m_lines <- m_lines[nzchar(trimws(m_lines))]
pos <- regexpr(":", m_lines, fixed = TRUE)
mf <- setNames(trimws(substring(m_lines, pos + 1)), trimws(substring(m_lines, 1, pos - 1)))

get <- function(key) if (key %in% names(mf)) mf[[key]] else "NOFILE"
has <- function(path) !is.na(path) && nzchar(path) && toupper(path) != "NOFILE" && file.exists(path)
flt <- function(path) if (grepl("\\.flt$", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) path else paste0(path, ".flt")
note <- function(...) cat("\n\n*", ..., "*\n\n", sep = "")

# Downsample to about max_cells for display, so the html stays emailable.
show_rast <- function(path, max_cells = 1.5e6) {
  r <- rast(path)
  f <- ceiling(sqrt(ncell(r) / max_cells))
  if (f > 1) r <- aggregate(r, f, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
  r
}
# LSstats csvs start with a "Raster file: ..." line before the header.
read_csv <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  if (length(lines) && grepl("^\\s*Raster file:", lines[1])) lines <- lines[-1]
  utils::read.csv(text = lines, check.names = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
}
table_or_note <- function(path, what, n = Inf) {
  if (has(path)) {
    d <- read_csv(path)
    print(kable(utils::head(d, n), digits = 4))
  } else note(what, " not available (", basename(path), ").")
}
div_pal <- grDevices::hcl.colors(101, "Blue-Red 3", rev = TRUE)
```

**Study:** `r get("study_name")`
**Created:** `r get("created")`

```{r inputs, results = "asis"}
keys <- c("clip_polygon", "target_crs", "ref_dtm", "align_dtm", "ref_dsm", "align_dsm", "ril_dem")
print(kable(data.frame(Item = keys, Value = vapply(keys, get, ""), row.names = NULL)))
if (!has(get("ref_dsm")) || !has(get("align_dsm"))) note("No DSM pair: Align ran without canopy terms.")
```

```{r area-map, fig.cap = "Reference DTM (hillshade) and study polygon."}
ref_dtm <- flt(get("ref_dtm"))
hs <- NULL
if (has(ref_dtm)) {
  dem <- show_rast(ref_dtm)
  hs <- shade(terrain(dem, "slope", unit = "radians"), terrain(dem, "aspect", unit = "radians"))
  plot(hs, col = grey(0:100 / 100), legend = FALSE, mar = c(2, 2, 1, 4))
  if (has(get("clip_polygon"))) plot(project(vect(get("clip_polygon")), crs(dem)), add = TRUE, border = "red", lwd = 2)
}
```

## Alignment

```{r align-tables, results = "asis"}
run_dir <- get("align_run_dir")
cat("\n### Run summary\n\n")
f <- file.path(run_dir, "align_run.csv")
if (has(f)) {
  d <- read_csv(f)
  print(kable(data.frame(Field = names(d), Value = vapply(d[1, ], as.character, "")), row.names = FALSE))
} else note("align_run.csv not available.")
cat("\n### Convergence by iteration\n\n")
table_or_note(file.path(run_dir, "align_iterations.csv"), "Iteration table")
cat("\n### Tile and prior selection (block cross-validation)\n\n")
table_or_note(file.path(run_dir, "align_select.csv"), "Cross-validation table")
```

```{r node-map, fig.cap = "Joint-fit node shifts relative to the global solution (mm)."}
f <- file.path(run_dir, "align_nodes.csv")
if (has(f)) {
  d <- read_csv(f)
  nm <- tolower(names(d))
  xi <- which(nm %in% c("x", "x_m", "xmap"))[1]; yi <- which(nm %in% c("y", "y_m", "ymap"))[1]
  dx <- grep("^(dx|shift_x|x_shift)", nm)[1]; dy <- grep("^(dy|shift_y|y_shift)", nm)[1]
  dz <- grep("^(dz|shift_z|z_shift)", nm)[1]
  if (!is.na(xi) && !is.na(yi)) {
    z <- if (!is.na(dz)) d[[dz]] else rep(0, nrow(d))
    lim <- max(abs(z), na.rm = TRUE); if (!is.finite(lim) || lim == 0) lim <- 1
    cols <- div_pal[round(50 * z / lim) + 51]
    if (!is.null(hs)) plot(hs, col = grey(0:100 / 100), legend = FALSE, mar = c(2, 2, 1, 4))
    else plot(d[[xi]], d[[yi]], type = "n", asp = 1, xlab = "x", ylab = "y")
    points(d[[xi]], d[[yi]], pch = 21, bg = cols, cex = 1.4)
    if (!is.na(dx) && !is.na(dy)) {
      s <- 0.05 * diff(range(d[[xi]])) / max(sqrt(d[[dx]]^2 + d[[dy]]^2), 1e-9, na.rm = TRUE)
      arrows(d[[xi]], d[[yi]], d[[xi]] + s * d[[dx]], d[[yi]] + s * d[[dy]], length = 0.05)
    }
    legend("bottomright", bg = "white", title = "vertical (mm)", pch = 21, pt.bg = div_pal[c(1, 51, 101)],
           legend = signif(c(-lim, 0, lim), 2))
  } else print(kable(utils::head(d, 30), digits = 3))
}
```

## Noise reference from flight-pass overlaps

Each survey's own noise, measured where two of its flight passes overlap: each pass's ground
points are triangulated alone and the surfaces differenced. Passes flown minutes apart hold no
real change, so this measures each survey's own noise independently of the DoD: a floor under the
level of detection, not the whole of it. IQRs and tails are of the difference between two
single-pass surfaces.

```{r noise, results = "asis"}
nd <- get("strip_noise_dir")
noise_cls <- list()
if (!has(nd)) {
  note("No noise reference: strip_noise.R was not run (noise_run: FALSE).")
} else {
  labs <- c(ref = get("noise_ref_label"), align = get("noise_align_label"))
  for (sv in names(labs)) {
    nf <- function(x) file.path(nd, paste0(labs[[sv]], "_noise_", x))
    cat("\n### Survey ", labs[[sv]], "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (has(nf("summary.txt"))) cat(paste0("- ", readLines(nf("summary.txt"), warn = FALSE)), sep = "\n")
    else note("No summary (", basename(nf("summary.txt")), ").")
    cat("\n")
    if (has(nf("pairs.csv"))) {
      pr <- utils::read.csv(nf("pairs.csv")); off <- abs(pr$median_m)
      print(kable(data.frame(`Pass pairs` = nrow(pr), `Cells (M)` = round(sum(pr$cells) / 1e6, 1),
                             `Median offset (m)` = median(off), `90th percentile (m)` = unname(quantile(off, 0.9)),
                             `Max (m)` = max(off), check.names = FALSE), digits = 3,
                  caption = "Vertical offset between overlapping passes (absolute median difference per tile and pair)"))
      if (max(off) > 0.1) note("Some passes are offset by more than 0.1 m: a systematic strip error in this survey, ",
                               "which shows in the DoD as offsets along flight lines, not as random noise.")
    }
    d <- tryCatch(utils::read.csv(nf("classes.csv")), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(d) && "iqr_m" %in% names(d) && nrow(d)) noise_cls[[sv]] <- d
  }
  if (length(noise_cls) == 2) {
    a <- noise_cls$ref; b <- noise_cls$align
    tb <- merge(a[, c("canopy", "slope", "cells", "iqr_m", "gt10", "gt20")],
                b[, c("canopy", "slope", "cells", "iqr_m", "gt10", "gt20")], by = c("canopy", "slope"),
                suffixes = paste0(" ", labs), sort = FALSE)
    tb <- tb[order(match(tb$canopy, a$canopy), match(tb$slope, a$slope)), ]   # strip_noise.R's class order
    cat("\n### Pass differences by class\n\n")
    print(kable(tb, digits = c(0, 0, 0, 3, 5, 6, 0, 3, 5, 6), row.names = FALSE,
                caption = "Cells, IQR (m), and share beyond 10 and 20 IQRs, by canopy height (m) and gradient"))
  }
}
```

```{r noise-floor, results = "asis"}
# Pass-noise floor: each survey's single-pass noise against ground density (IQR^2 = a + b/d, fitted
# on its pass pairs as 2a + b (1/d_a + 1/d_b)), read at the survey's own density at each cell
cdp <- get("out_cendif")
lod_iqr <- if (has(get("out_lod"))) sub("\\.flt$", "_iqr.flt", get("out_lod"), ignore.case = TRUE) else "NOFILE"
dcl <- if (has(nd)) lapply(c(ref = get("noise_ref_label"), align = get("noise_align_label")), function(l)
  tryCatch(utils::read.csv(file.path(nd, paste0(l, "_noise_density_classes.csv"))), error = function(e) NULL)) else list()
need <- c(cdp, lod_iqr, get("ref_dtm"), get("align_dtm"), get("ref_dsm"), get("align_dsm"),
          get("ref_ground_count"), get("align_ground_count"))
if (length(dcl) == 2 && all(vapply(dcl, function(d) !is.null(d) && "inv_density_sum" %in% names(d), TRUE)) &&
    all(vapply(need, has, TRUE))) {
  cat("\n### Pass-noise floor against Align's level of detection\n\n")
  brk <- function(l) sort(unique(as.numeric(unlist(regmatches(l, gregexpr("[0-9.]+", l))))))
  lab <- function(b, pre) c(paste0(pre, "<", b[1]), if (length(b) > 1) paste0(pre, b[-length(b)], "-", b[-1]), paste0(pre, ">=", b[length(b)]))
  cb <- brk(dcl$ref$canopy); sb <- brk(dcl$ref$slope)
  smp <- spatSample(rast(cdp), 1e6, method = "regular", xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  xy <- as.matrix(smp[, c("x", "y")])
  ex <- function(p) extract(rast(p), xy, method = "simple")[[1]]
  h1 <- ex(get("ref_dsm")) - ex(get("ref_dtm")); h2 <- ex(get("align_dsm")) - ex(get("align_dtm"))
  g <- if (has(get("out_gradient"))) ex(get("out_gradient")) else rep(0, nrow(smp))
  dz <- smp[[3]]; ai <- ex(lod_iqr)
  # Ground returns per m2 of each survey, over 5 x 5 count cells
  den <- lapply(c(get("ref_ground_count"), get("align_ground_count")), function(p) {
    cr <- rast(p); rc <- rowColFromCell(cr, cellFromXY(cr, xy)); tot <- 0
    for (dr in -2:2) for (dc in -2:2) { v <- cr[cellFromRowCol(cr, rc[, 1] + dr, rc[, 2] + dc)][[1]]; tot <- tot + ifelse(is.na(v), 0, v) }
    tot / (25 * prod(res(cr)))
  })
  c1 <- findInterval(h1, cb); c2 <- findInterval(h2, cb); gs <- findInterval(g, sb)
  key <- paste(lab(cb, "")[c1 + 1], lab(sb, "g")[gs + 1])
  floor_iqr <- function(d, k) {      # one survey's single-pass IQR at density d, class key k
    f <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d, paste(d$canopy, d$slope)), function(x) {
      x <- x[x$cells >= 5000, ]
      if (nrow(x) < 2) return(NULL)
      cf <- coef(lm(I(iqr_m^2) ~ inv_density_sum, data = x, weights = cells))
      data.frame(key = paste(x$canopy[1], x$slope[1]), a = max(cf[1] / 2, 0), b = max(cf[2], 0))
    }))
    j <- match(k, f$key)
    function(dens) sqrt(f$a[j] + f$b[j] / pmax(dens, 0.05))
  }
  fl <- sqrt(floor_iqr(dcl$ref, key)(den[[1]])^2 + floor_iqr(dcl$align, key)(den[[2]])^2)
  dmin <- pmin(den[[1]], den[[2]])
  db <- c(0.25, 0.75, 2, 4)
  dlab <- lab(db, "")
  ok <- !is.na(dz) & !is.na(ai) & ai > 0 & !is.na(fl) & !is.na(c1) & !is.na(c2) & c1 == c2
  grp <- paste(c1, findInterval(dmin, db))
  x <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(which(ok), grp[ok], drop = TRUE), function(i) {
    if (length(i) < 300) return(NULL)
    data.frame(canopy = lab(cb, "")[c1[i[1]] + 1], density = dlab[findInterval(dmin[i[1]], db) + 1], cells = length(i),
               iqr_obs = IQR(dz[i]), align = median(ai[i]), floor = median(fl[i]),
               share = min(median(fl[i])^2 / IQR(dz[i])^2, 1))
  }))
  x <- x[order(match(x$canopy, lab(cb, "")), match(x$density, dlab)), ]
  print(kable(x, digits = c(0, 0, 0, 3, 3, 3, 2), row.names = FALSE,
              col.names = c("Canopy (m)", "Sparser survey's ground returns / m2", "Cells sampled", "Observed IQR (m)",
                            "Align's IQR (m)", "Pass-noise floor (m)", "Floor's share of observed variance"),
              caption = "Align's centred difference on cells whose canopy class is the same in both surveys (all gradients)"))
  note("The floor is the noise each survey has on its own -- measured between its flight passes and read at its ground ",
       "density at the cell -- combined for the two surveys. It is a lower bound, not a prediction: the rest of the ",
       "observed IQR is what differs between the surveys (ground classification, DTM gridding, sensor, season, ",
       "alignment) and real change, and that part also grows as ground returns thin. Align's IQR is the level of ",
       "detection; where the floor's share is small, more points would not lower it, while more consistent processing ",
       "of the two surveys might.")
} else if (has(nd)) {
  note("Pass-noise floor skipped: it needs strip_noise.R's density classes, the centred difference, Align's IQR raster, ",
       "both DTMs and DSMs, and both ground-count rasters.")
}
```

## Candidate landslides

```{r patch-map, results = "asis", fig.cap = "Candidate landslide patches over the reference hillshade."}
pr <- get("patch_raster")
if (has(pr)) {
  p <- rast(pr)
  f <- ceiling(sqrt(ncell(p) / 1.5e6))
  if (f > 1) p <- aggregate(p, f, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)
  p <- classify(p, cbind(0, NA))
  if (!is.null(hs)) plot(hs, col = grey(0:100 / 100), legend = FALSE, mar = c(2, 2, 1, 4))
  plot(p > 0, col = "red", legend = FALSE, add = !is.null(hs))
} else note("No patch raster.")
```

```{r patch-table, results = "asis"}
tb <- get("lshunter_table")
if (has(tb)) {
  d <- read_csv(tb)
  cat("\n", nrow(d), " patches in the patch table.\n\n", sep = "")
  num <- d[vapply(d, is.numeric, TRUE)]
  if (ncol(num)) {
    s <- t(vapply(num, function(v) c(min = min(v, na.rm = TRUE), median = stats::median(v, na.rm = TRUE),
                                     mean = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(v, na.rm = TRUE),
                                     total = sum(v, na.rm = TRUE)), numeric(5)))
    print(kable(s, digits = 3))
  }
  shp <- get("patch_polygons")
  if (has(shp)) {
    cat("\nPolygons: `", shp, "` (", nrow(vect(shp, what = "attributes")), " features; every field is described in `",
        basename(sub("\\.shp$", "_fields.csv", shp, ignore.case = TRUE)), "`).\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  nul <- sub("\\.csv$", "_null.csv", tb, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (has(nul)) { cat("\n### Null simulation\n\n"); table_or_note(nul, "Null table", 30) }
} else note("No LShunter patch table.")
```

## Landforms

```{r landform-map, results = "asis", fig.cap = "Landform classes."}
lf <- get("landform_raster")
if (has(lf)) {
  r <- rast(lf)
  f <- ceiling(sqrt(ncell(r) / 1.5e6))
  if (f > 1) r <- aggregate(r, f, fun = "modal", na.rm = TRUE)
  if (has(get("clip_polygon"))) r <- crop(r, project(vect(get("clip_polygon")), crs(r)))
  plot(as.factor(r), col = grDevices::hcl.colors(10, "Dark 3"))
} else note("No landform raster.")
```

```{r lsstats, results = "asis"}
base <- get("lsstats_csv")
rl <- trimws(strsplit(get("lsstats_rasters"), ";")[[1]])
found <- FALSE
for (i in seq_along(rl)) {
  lfc <- paste0(base, "_landforms_", i, ".csv")
  if (has(lfc)) {
    found <- TRUE
    src <- sub("^\\s*Raster file:\\s*", "", readLines(lfc, n = 1, warn = FALSE))
    cat("\n### ", basename(if (nzchar(src)) src else rl[i]), " by landform\n\n", sep = "")
    print(kable(read_csv(lfc), digits = 3))
  }
}
if (!found) note("No LSstats landform summaries.")
```
